title: VAPPEBY bluetooth speaker
description: VAPPEBY bluetooth speaker, gen 3/black, 8x8" VAPPEBY Bluetooth speaker, gen 3 has a clear, powerful sound – and comes with the Spotify Tap™ playback function. Get two for stereo sound at home or add a battery and bring your music everywhere.
features: May be completed with ENEBY battery for 25 hours of playtime, sold separately.
A button on the back allows you to choose a function that automatically turns the speaker off if no music is played for 20 minutes or to always keep the Bluetooth connection active.
Special waste handling may be required. Please contact your local authorities for more information.
VAPPEBY Bluetooth speaker 7⅞x7⅞", gen 3 is the successor of ENEBY Bluetooth speaker 7⅞x7⅞", gen 2.
materialAndCare: Front panel/ Back panel/ Button: ABS plastic (min. 50% recycled); Handle: Aluminum; Knob: ABS plastic; Screw: Steel; Fabric cover: 100 % polyester (100% recycled); Connecting plate: ABS plastic
